questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A ball is thrown vertically upward with a speed of 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s², the maximum height reached by the ball is:
questions.explanation: At the highest point the velocity becomes zero. Using v² = u² − 2gh: 0 = 20² − 2 × 10 × h, so h = 400 / 20 = 20 m.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.chapter: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Which of the following elements has the highest first ionisation enthalpy?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen has a stable half-filled 2p³ configuration, so removing an electron needs extra energy. That is why its first ionisation enthalpy is higher than that of oxygen, even though oxygen is to its right in the period.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: In chloroplasts, ATP synthesis during the light reaction (photophosphorylation) takes place across the membrane of the:
questions.explanation: Protons accumulate inside the thylakoid lumen during the light reaction. They flow back to the stroma through ATP synthase (CF0–CF1) embedded in the thylakoid membrane, and this proton gradient drives ATP synthesis — chemiosmosis.
